details: A top vertex of a contained cube has one lower neighbour in each cube coordinate.
name: Maximum Positive Degree / Largest Strongly Shattered Set
proof: In a contained $d$-cube, its top vertex has $d$ smaller $1$-inclusion neighbours.  Hence maximum positive degree is at least the largest strongly shattered-set size.
witness_verification: For C_+, the top vertex 111 has three smaller one-inclusion neighbours, while the largest contained cube is an edge. Thus maximum positive degree is 3 and largest strong-shattering size is 1; sync/verify_positive_degree_gap.py checks both quantities.
